home.practice_deflectors_blurb: Tap a mirror to flip it. Route every beam to the port that wears its sign through exactly the lenses its recipe asks for, by the longest way you can find, then fire.
deflectors.title: Deflectors
deflectors.how_to: Two beams come in from the ports on the edge. Tap a mirror to flip it, and route each beam to the port that wears its sign, through exactly the lenses drawn beside that port: no fewer and no others. Take as long as you like, then tap a lit entry to fire. A beam that gets home scores by the mirrors it turned at, turns plus one squared, and half as much again for each lens. A beam out anywhere else, or through the wrong lenses, hits the hull and costs 40. Every mirror a beam turned at is spent: the mirrors above it drop and a fresh one comes in at the top.
deflectors.how_to_keyboard: Arrows or WASD move the cursor, space or enter flips the mirror under it, F fires the volley.
deflectors.lines_note: A beam that is not home draws a broken line to where it would leave. The dots run back from its exit. Where the two cross at a mirror, flipping that mirror joins them; then bend the route through the lenses its recipe asks for.
deflectors.streak_note: A volley with every beam home builds a streak that multiplies the next clean volley, up to double. The strip over the grid says what the volley is worth now and the best it could be; a volley worth its best is perfect and scores half as much again.
deflectors.recipe_note: Each exit wears its recipe: one or two lenses, drawn small outside the port. A glass is faint until the beam's route passes a lens of its kind. A lens on the route that is not in the recipe is ringed in danger: it spoils the beam.
deflectors.spend_note: Every mirror a fired beam turned at is spent. What stood above it in its column drops one cell, and a fresh mirror comes in at the top, so each volley changes the grid the next is dealt on.
deflectors.hint_note: Practice rounds pulse the next mirror to flip when you pause.
deflectors.legend_entry: Entry: a solid sign. Tap it to fire the volley now. An amber ring round it says every beam is home.
deflectors.legend_exit: Exit: the same sign with its middle cut out. It fills when the beam is home.
deflectors.legend_mirror: Mirror. Tap to flip it; a beam turns at every mirror it meets.
deflectors.legend_recipe: A lens. A beam runs straight through it. The small glasses outside an exit are the lenses that beam must pass, and no others.
deflectors.legend_home: A solid line, beaded with the beam's sign: the beam is home.
deflectors.legend_astray: A broken line and a cross: the beam would hit the hull there, at the wrong port or at its own through the wrong lenses.
deflectors.legend_back: Dots: the way back from the exit.
studio.preset.deflectors_no_recipes: No lenses: routes to exits only
studio.preset.deflectors_still: Mirrors never spent: one grid all round
studio.preset.deflectors_sparse: Ten mirrors: few routes, short ones
studio.preset.deflectors_dense: Eighteen mirrors: long routes, hard to join
studio.preset.deflectors_big_grid: A big grid: eight by eight, 24 mirrors, five lenses
